companies.name: Algaenic
companies.description: Algaenic has developed a low-cost, low-energy system that detects, removes and then harvests Harmful Algal Blooms (HABs) for biomass that can be sold as feedstock or energy.

companies.name: Viridys Bio
companies.description: Viridys develops low-cost, non-living, biosensor devices that detect volatile organic compounds (VOCs), the early-stage stress signals emitted by plants.

companies.name: Mushroom+
companies.description: mushroom+ is a deep-tech platform using advanced molecular engineering techniques to boost the natural protein content of mushrooms by 10X to match that of meat.

companies.name: HexSeed Technology
companies.description: HexSeed is a UK advanced materials and carbon utilisation start-up developing lab-grown industrial diamond as a thermal material for next-generation semiconductors.​

companies.name: Climingo
companies.description: Climingo is building a platform that helps organisations choose and use the most accurate weather and climate forecasts to prevent damage, improve resilience and reduce emissions.

companies.name: White Lotus Energies
companies.description: White Lotus Energies’ photosynthesis inspired platform turns CO2‚ into clean fuels and chemicals. Their first product is green methanol for aviation, shipping, and industry

companies.name: Wempyre
companies.description: Wempyre converts plastic waste into energy and resources in a decentralized manner–directly at companies’ premises, in containers.

companies.name: TetraxAI
companies.description: TetraxAI helps renewable energy developers and investors automate due diligence and risk assessment – 100x faster, 10x cheaper, with full traceability.

companies.name: TerraTrace
companies.description: Building a new standard: an autonomous soil gas flux monitoring system that delivers real-time data, geospatial analysis, and uncertainty metrics, without the need for constant human intervention.

companies.name: Terasort
companies.description: TeraSort is leveraging major cost reductions in robotics and advances in AI to massively reduce recycling capex and opex and recover more material from the process. Their plug-in, fully robotic, modular recycling units provide easily deployable, low cost, end to end recycling sorting capacity.

companies.name: tenax ai
companies.description: Tenax ai is the property-level risk intelligence infrastructure enabling insurers to make confident underwriting decisions in high-exposure markets. Their AI-native computer vision platform converts ground-truth imagery – captured via mobile or drone – into structured, geo-located, time-stamped risk data, delivering audit-ready verification and mitigation insight at the individual property level.

companies.name: S2S Dynamics
companies.description: A German climate-tech startup that builds digital software to improve e-waste circularity and streamline recycling processes. Their platform bridges the gap between electronics producers and recyclers to track, trace, and recover value from electronic waste efficiently.

companies.name: Nendo
companies.description: Nendo’s clay-rich food based subsurface irrigation system delivers water directly to plant roots, eliminating evaporation and dramatically improving soil health – that current systems.

companies.name: FloatSync
companies.description: FloatSync has invented a mobile plastic recycling hardware able to process material no one else is capturing currently. Their systems can be deployed at any location around the world, fitting a 20-foot shipping container. They consider it crucial to apply their technology to address the plastic pollution issue and facilitate decentralised recycling.

companies.name: Fidelis AI
companies.description: Fidelis AI is developing foundational technology for Physical AI, enabling faster and more scalable development of autonomous systems through accessible dataset generation, simulation, and embodied intelligence. Their platform helps organisations build safer, more capable AI-driven systems while reducing the time, cost, and computational resources required for real-world deployment.

companies.name: Fetch Energy
companies.description: Fetch Energy is developing a new approach to wave power, aiming to make it smaller, cheaper, and more practical than previous wave-energy technologies. Rather than focusing only on large-scale electricity grids, the company is targeting applications that need reliable power at or near the source, such as marine vessels, research operations, and other maritime users.

companies.name: COOLoop
companies.description: COOloop is a London-based deep-tech company developing a proprietary catalyst platform to convert CO₂ and green hydrogen directly into ultra-low carbon ethanol. Their technology is based on a novel metal-organic framework (MOF) derived catalyst, originally developed through PhD and postdoctoral research at Monash University.

companies.name: Composite Designers
companies.description: Composite Designers develops carbon-negative construction materials that permanently sequester carbon while integrating seamlessly into existing building practices. Their proprietary biochar-based composites offer price parity with conventional alternatives. They are also launching brick slips that reduce embodied carbon without requiring changes to installation methods, tools, or workflows.

companies.name: Bravely Cultured
companies.description: Selecting for novel marine microorganisms and screening for their ability to produce bioactive compounds with an aim to promote the green transition by expanding biomanufacturing toolkit.

companies.name: Auralytica
companies.description: Auralytica builds colour changing hydrogel sensors without dyes or electronics. They are starting with food producers, creating sensors for the critical control points that determine whether food is safe, fresh, and sellable.

companies.name: Astracite
companies.description: Astracite is developing sustainable, high-performance anode materials for lithium-ion batteries using CO₂, silicon, and recycled graphite from end-of-life batteries. Their technology is designed to increase battery capacity, reduce reliance on fossil fuel graphite, and build a more resilient and sustainable battery supply chain in Europe.

companies.name: Layrr
companies.description: Rare minerals such as solid silver, gold, and platinum are essential to build key technology in a wide range of sectors from energy to aerospace. Layrr have found a way to transform how we produce rare minerals using a atomic level coating know as physical vapor desposition. Cheap material cores such as stainless steel are coated with a fine later of precious metal, giving the atom the ability to carry out the same properties as the rare material alternative. This method uses 90% less of precious materials, produces lighter alternatives, with no chemical waste or hazardous solvents.

companies.name: Shifted
companies.description: We desperately need renewable energy, yet we are wasting it! Wind and solar PV are growing exponentially, which will dramatically increase curtailment. Li-ion batteries are competitive for storing 30 min to 4 hours of electricity. But this is not enough. Only long duration energy storage allows to save this electricity and meet the complete peak demand.

companies.name: MannyAI
companies.description: Pattern Project offers an AI-driven supply chain and digital twin service for made-to-order garment manufacturing, enabling the fashion industry to move away from mass manufacturing and eliminate the overproduction of 30 billion garments annually. Their service optimises production, reduces waste, and enables more sustainable fashion production.

companies.name: Kita
companies.description: Kita’s vision is to be the world’s first carbon insurer, de-risking carbon removal solutions to accelerate their ability to scale. ​ The climate crisis requires carbon removal solutions to remove carbon from the atmosphere. Many carbon removal solutions rely on revenue from selling carbon units on the voluntary carbon markets. However, these units lack tailored insurance products for their key risks, particularly under-delivery on pre-paid contracts.​ Kita removes this “carbon delivery risk” from sellers and buyers in the market, using insurance products that guarantee the quality and delivery of carbon units and carbon removal solutions.​

companies.name: Cocoon
companies.description: To decarbonise the world, we are going to have to build a lot more. This means we will need more steel and cement over the next 40 years than ever before. However, these two materials represent 15% of global emissions. We’re capturing CO₂ into industrial waste and upcycling this into a green cement alternative to decarbonise the steel and cement industries. This mineralisation process has been the focus of our Chief Scientist Officer’s research and we’re now commercialising it at scale.

companies.name: BioZeroc
companies.description: BioZeroc is decarbonising the construction industry by creating carbon-negative construction materials from waste products.​ Their expertise in bio- and nanotech has allowed them to bypass the need for cement in concrete manufacturing, at minimal cost to producers and the environment.

companies.name: Elaniti
companies.description: Elaniti leverages advances in both machine learning and DNA sequencing to predict key crop outcomes from soil biology, empowering growers to make data-driven agronomic decisions at scale.

companies.name: HavenWise
companies.description: At Havenwise, we believe that heat pumps are the future. That’s why we’ve built a software-only solution to make them easier, cheaper, and more reliable — for both homeowners and installers. Effortless comfort: Set your comfort preferences in the Havenwise app. Energy bill savings: Save 40% on your energy bill. Havenwise ensures your heat pump runs efficiently and accounts for your electricity tariff. Peace of mind: We monitor your heat pump remotely and spot issues before you do — preventing call-outs.

companies.name: Lorefully
companies.description: Lorefully is an AI-powered knowledge engine that captures unstructured data from fragmented silos within communities to surface the value held within. Whether it’s technicians on a solar installation, visitors at a trade show, or educators in the field, critical knowledge is often shared informally and lost once the moment passes. Lorefully turns those fleeting interactions into structured insight—harvested, organised, and activated through a proprietary AI pipeline. The platform connects key stakeholder groups: Communities with their OEMs. These groups often sit in silos, each holding pieces of operational wisdom, lived experience, or frontline feedback. Lorefully breaks down those barriers by drawing insights from questions asked, stories shared, and challenges encountered—at the point of use, not in hindsight. By enabling people to learn from each other in real-time, Lorefully reduces the need to relearn what others already know. This unlocks a faster, more efficient path to action—particularly vital in high-stakes areas like the clean energy transition or complex infrastructure delivery. Ultimately, Lorefully helps organisations accelerate progress by making institutional knowledge cumulative, not repetitive. It ensures wisdom gained today isn’t lost tomorrow, driving long-term value, resilience, and momentum.

companies.name: Grouse Fiber
companies.description: At Grouse Fibre, we are not the first to see the value in recovering milk proteins and using them as building blocks of milk. We stand on the shoulders of researchers in the 1930’s and 1940’s who developed a milk protein fibre to replace wool. This product was called Lanital in the UK and other versions of milk casein fibre were developed in the USA and Italy. These fibres were designed for consumer apparel and never really had the properties to be a long term success. Our approach is to lean into the characteristics of the casein fibre to target application where they have most value add. This includes horticulture but also defense, industrial and biomedical.

companies.name: Forge Minerals
companies.description: Forge is focused on adaptation of commercially available chemical process Equipment to accelerate its path to scalability. This state-of-the-art equipment benefits from small footprint and adaptibility for integration with existing industrial processes. With our Carbon Sequestration Equipment, companies can effectively store large quantities of carbon dioxide and help mitigate the impact of greenhouse gas emissions.

companies.name: Temperate
companies.description: Temperate is building next generation, sustainable air cooling technology that keeps you cool at a fraction of the running cost, by beaming heat into outer space.

companies.name: Lambda Quantech
companies.description: Lambda Quantech provides low-cost IoT sensors and an AI-driven analytics platform for real-time monitoring and quantification of fugitive methane emissions at biogas plants.

companies.name: Demeter Bio
companies.description: Demeter Bio’s flagship product, MelioShield, is a next generation biopolymer derived from black soldier flies, a high-performance alternative to synthetic materials across cosmetics, healthcare, packaging, and biotech industries.

companies.name: Orchid Solar
companies.description: Orchid Solar is replacing diesel generators in remote mining with modular, high-temperature solar technology. Based on research from Oxford University, the novel, patented, mirror and heat storage systems provide clean, dispatchable power at a fraction of battery costs.

companies.name: Jupiter Lex
companies.description: Jupiter Lex addresses the lack of corporate accountability for climate harm by empowering legal professionals to seek justice more efficiently with AIdriven ESG litigation solutions.

companies.name: Intelligest
companies.description: Our name reflects our mission—to bring intelligence to biomethane production, helping biogas plants operate smarter, cleaner, and more profitably. At Intelligest, we are building an AI-driven optimisation platform that empowers biomethane plants to unlock their full potential. Our technology is unique: Our platform solves operational and biological efficiency issues and integrates seamlessly with operator tools. We combine machine learning and biological insights with decades of sector experience. Our mission is clear: Support the biomethane industry in scaling its decarbonisation impact, and empower plant operators. Research shows that biomethane could account for 30% Europe’s natural gas and reduce up to 0.1C warming.

companies.name: Loop52
companies.description: Loop52 enables a traceable circular economy for automotive plastics by sourcing and processing plastics recovered from End-of-Life Vehicles (ELVs). Through our novel sorting and processing technologies bespoke to Automotive Plastics, we produce high-quality, drop-in ELV derived recycled plastics.

companies.name: GreenFlip
companies.description: GreenFlip sources and analyses properties with high retrofit potential, providing instant investment analysis to capitalise on the zero energy bill premium.

companies.name: FutureAlgae
companies.description: FutureAlgae are pioneers in microalgae production, developing proprietary cultivation technology that allows us to sustainably and efficiently grow microalgae at scale for a variety of industries. Our technology uses waste heat, water, nutrients and CO2 emissions to create high-quality, nutrient-rich products without competing with food or agricultural systems.

companies.name: Remy
companies.description: Remy leverages AI and automation to reduce household food waste by 70%, helping users effortlessly understand what’s in their kitchen, when it expires, and how they can use it while offering the option to buy what’s missing — directly from their smartphones. In doing so, Remy collects novel user emissions and behaviour data to drastically improve corporate partners’ Scope 3 emissions reporting, commercial strategies and waste mitigation efforts.

companies.name: Eslando
companies.description: Eslando is a circular fashion tech startup on a mission to accelerate textile recycling. Our AI-powered sorting technology leverages digital product passports to sorts textile waste with pinpoint accuracy. Our solution slashes landfill waste, empowers fashion brands and waste management companies to efficiently recover materials at scale.

companies.name: Fermtech
companies.description: Fermtech are a climate biotech company from Oxford meeting the demand for affordable and sustainable protein ingredients. Their novel system converts side streams from the food industry, creating nutritious and flavourful products.

companies.name: Carbon Cell
companies.description: Carbon Cell are on a mission to make polystyrene waste a thing of the past. Their high performance, fully compostable and carbon negative biochar can be used for a wide variety of applications, from packaging to construction. This expanded foam locks in carbon for centuries, making it the eco-friendly alternative to polymer-based versions. Carbon Cell also boasts a renewable supply chain, with feedstock made from waste streams such as textiles or even potato peels

companies.name: BioNatural Solutions
companies.description: BNS transforms tropical fruit skin waste into an edible liquid biotech solution that extends food shelf life by up to 200%, revolutionising fresh product preservation through upcycling agribusiness waste. BNs has globally patented technology to reuse fresh organic waste and create chemical free preservation solutions. The solution aims to reduce food waste through shelf life extension and also upcycle materials that would otherwise go to waste.

companies.name: Anzen
companies.description: Anzen is the world’s first climate wall with solid-state heating, cooling, and heat recovery ventilation technology. Taking on the problem of indoor pollution and energy inefficiency, Anzen’s solution aims to decarbonise heating and cooling at scale with one-day installations while making indoor climate control inclusive and intuitive.

companies.name: Differential bio
companies.description: Biomanufacturing is at a pivotal moment, needing accelerated R&D to unleash its full potential, currently constrained by traditional and iterative lab-centric methods. fungtional.bio’s solution: digital-first experimentation through a digital twin of microbial fermentation, a strategy that promises to redefine efficiency and innovation in the sector.
companies.verticals: Food Systems; Materials and Chemicals; Platforms

companies.name: Adia Thermal
companies.description: Adia envisions a future where the energy transition is seamless. By leveraging commoditized hardware with digital twins of the built environment, Adia adapts our existing infrastructure to a decarbonized future.

companies.name: Mozaic Earth
companies.description: Mozaic Earth is empowering communities to become guardians of nature through tech-driven, high-frequency biodiversity data collection system to catalyze $1 trillion in private capital flow for transparent and impactful naturepositive initiatives.

companies.name: Deep Blue Biotech
companies.description: We believe in the power of synthetic biology to decarbonize many of our everyday chemicals. This will present a new and essential alternative to address the current climate crisis. By recreating the building blocks of our everyday economy, we will create the multiplier effect that we need now to make a real impact faster.

companies.name: Cbamboo
companies.description: Cbamboo’s mission is to drive firms to decarbonise their supply chains and minimise their carbon border taxes. Our software platform will keep companies compliant with the EU’s Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism, a new law applicable to EU importers in dozens of industries. We are developing AI tools to analyse embodied carbon, forecast CBAM costs, model the knock-on effects on prices, and report back on resulting sustainability metrics. Our products will address the needs of importers, who pay CBAM directly, as well as their suppliers and their customers. As carbon border taxes evolve and spread worldwide, Cbamboo plans to be at the forefront of helping firms to integrate these taxes into their management decisions.

companies.name: Climate-i
companies.description: Fluorinated gases (F-gases) are manufactured chemicals which play a critical role in cooling, refrigeration and electricity transmission globally. However, most are extremely potent greenhouse gases, thousands of times more powerful than CO2 and making up a similar share of emissions as global aviation. Climate-i is building technology to capture fugitive F-gases, starting with leaks of SF6 gas, a high voltage insulator used within electricity substations.

companies.name: Reaforma
companies.description: Reaforma is a prop-tech and climatetech start-up founded in 2022 out of the Carbon 13 accelerator programme and is on a mission to remove 10Mt of CO2e from the planet each year. They are creating the next generation of construction materials to change the way we look at buildings. By harnessing construction and industrial waste streams, they are reforming the construction materials of today to become the materials of the future. Reaforma is capturing biogenic carbon and locking it into building materials to cut the embodied carbon right in front of our faces. Non-structural elements of buildings contribute almost 70% of its total embodied carbon and so we’ll be bringing our solution to this area first. At the core of the start-up is giving access to green products with no premium for adopting sustainable products in design.

companies.name: HydraPulse
companies.description: Introducing the HydraPulse, a remarkable advancement in sustainable energy generation. Central to its design is the revolutionary Stephenson Turbine (TST), an impulse turbine technology that stands at the forefront of innovation. Enclosed within the HydraPulse, this pioneering turbine design achieves unparalleled efficiency and power output, surpassing conventional approaches.

companies.name: Optimise-AI
companies.description: Optimise-AI is transforming building energy management, through its virtualised Building Management System (BMS) technology, that harnesses the power of digital twins. This cutting-edge solution delivers actionable insights, even for the 90% of commercial buildings that currently lack a traditional BMS. As a result, clients consistently achieve impressive energy and carbon savings, typically exceeding 40%.

companies.name: CoolRun
companies.description: The cold chain logistics industry stands at the crossroads of increasing demand and environmental challenges. Traditional methods, often energy-intensive and inefficient, contribute significantly to global emissions and lack the agility to adapt to a rapidly changing market. CoolRun rises to this challenge with our unique Pods, utilizing advanced phase change materials (PCMs) and bringing modularity across the cold chain. These Pods maintain diverse temperature needs across shipments, ensuring products remain in optimal condition while dramatically reducing energy consumption. By transforming the way goods are transported, CoolRun is not just meeting the demands of today but setting the standard for tomorrow.

companies.name: Future Greens
companies.description: The solution is to integrate anaerobic digestion with vertical farming, to capture energy, CO₂ and fertiliser from organic waste and use it to power their controlled growing systems which produce the freshest pesticide-free produce year-round. The unique integration of vertical farming with renewable energy generation through AD results in sustainable, carbon-negative food production and brings vertical farming closer to large-scale viability.

companies.name: Kestrix
companies.description: Kestrix is using mass drone image capture and AI to unlock building portfolio decarbonisation at scale. By mapping regions with drones and extracting retrofit-relevant data from images using computer vision and machine learning, Kestrix paints a picture of the real-world energy performance in any building and shows retrofit opportunities in seconds – saving portfolio owners and operators retrofit planning time and de-risking large-scale projects.
companies.team: Lucy Lyons – CEO Matt Goodridge – CTO

companies.name: Fidata
companies.description: Fidata is a one-stop digital platform where investment managers can access all impact data generated by their sustainable investments. Fidata’s unique technology will automatically collect, correct, benchmark, and predict impact data, giving peace of mind to investment managers to effortlessly report their impact and meet their regulatory reporting obligations.

companies.name: xtonnes
companies.description: xtonnes is next generation carbon management platform empowering enterprises of any size to reduce emissions and start their journey to Net Zero. Using minimal data combined with state-of-the-art data science, businesses can begin to take control of their emissions in minutes, effortlessly remain up to date with changes to reporting standards, discover ways to reduce their footprints and achieve science-based targets.​

companies.name: Preoptima
companies.description: As a Carbon Twin, Preoptima mirrors every design choice, instantly evaluating the whole life carbon (WLC) impact of decisions. Both their Web App and API provide unprecedented access to real-time carbon impact data, an accurate bill of quantities, and associated material and structural impact information. By harnessing the power of geolocation and real-time analysis, Preoptima allows users to visualise and understand the WLC footprint of their projects from the earliest stages, helping avoid embodied carbon and reduce emissions from the outset.

companies.name: Offgrid.Finance
companies.description: Offgrid.Finance works with clean and productive-use technology vendors to provide financing to their SME customers in emerging markets. The online platform uses advanced risk analytics and AI to connect green capital and impact investors to small and growing businesses and solve one of their biggest problems: access to capital, enabling them to both grow and reduce their greenhouse gas emissions​.

companies.name: MapMortar
companies.description: Mapmortar is supercharging retrofit strategies. Their breakthrough proprietary simulation technology helps organisations understand how to achieve net zero for entire portfolios three times as fast, with twice the accuracy.

companies.name: Samudra Oceans
companies.description: Samudra is a Robotics and AI company that can scale seaweed farming 1000x. Samudra makes swarms of monitoring robots equipped with sensors and cameras that can detect pathogens, check nutrient or acidity levels and report back on biomass growth.​ ​ This reduces the cost and effort of monitoring by several times enabling seaweed farms to scale to their full potential with minimal labour and less fuel-intensive boat trips to monitor. As Seaweed can capture up to 50x more carbon than land-based trees, this is an effective way to reverse the climate crisis while providing a valuable product to the world.

companies.name: Sun Bear Biofuture
companies.description: Sun Bear Biofuture is reimagining farming with precision fermentation to produce sustainable and healthier everyday ingredients, starting with a palm oil alternative.​ Using computational modelling and synthetic biology they are developing a deforestation-free, drop-in palm oil substitute, with waste materials as their feedstock, to change how we produce our food and fuels.

companies.name: Limetrack
companies.description: Limetrack adds value to commercial food waste by redefining the physical and digital infrastructure to increase customer profits and help the planet. Our access-controlled SMART IoT bins and digital infrastructure effortlessly collect data on every food waste deposit and deliver tangible benefits to businesses, reducing their food waste costs by up to £6,000 per annum. Intelligent data analytics and SMART bin notifications help waste management companies optimise their routes, keep operators safe and cut costs by avoiding unnecessary stops. And our clear, concise reporting keeps all our customers on the right side of the new separated waste legislation.

companies.name: Tierra Sphere
companies.description: Tierra Foods is a food company for the 21st Century. They are optimising the potential of highly nutritious, but under-used plants from the Central American rainforest into innovative, carbon-negative ingredients for B2B. At the same time, they are also enabling soil regeneration, restoring biodiversity and capturing carbon. A truly regenerative business, they are driving system change, demonstrating how agriculture and food production can be reinvented to work in harmony with nature and communities​.

companies.name: Open Hydro
companies.description: Open Hydro is the leading platform that automates water GHG emissions quantification, allocation, and mitigation opportunities at any given point in the supply chain. The platform provides the most accurate water emissions data aligned with internationally recognised reporting frameworks.​ In doing so, they help mobilise climate-aligned investments in water infrastructures to ensure the decarbonisation of freshwater systems.

companies.name: Ki Hydrogen
companies.description: Ki Hydrogen is a deep-tech climate venture using biomass electrolysis to produce green hydrogen at cost parity to fossil fuel based hydrogen. Their innovative technology uses up to 75% less energy compared with water electrolysis, while also producing valuable chemical commodities to be sold as co-products.

companies.name: AED energy
companies.description: Aed Energy designs and builds thermal energy storage technology enabling reliable, clean, and low-cost power. We aim to radically advance the long duration energy storage market by providing deployable, low-cost thermal storage batteries – a critical enabler for the widescale deployment of renewable energy across electricity grids worldwide.

companies.name: Bluemethane
companies.description: There are 3 billion tonnes of CO2e emissions from water per year due to methane. Currently there is no way to remove this methane at scale, until now. Bluemethane is a technology startup developing a first-of-a-kind, scalable data and hardware solution to capture a billion tonnes of greenhouse gases from water. With methane’s global warming power 34x that of carbon, Bluemethane is tackling a core problem for global warming.
companies.team: Nestor Rueda-Vallejo , CTO Louise Parlons Bentata , CEO

companies.name: PuriFire Energy
companies.description: PuriFire is pioneering the production of green chemicals and fuels from wastewater. Their patented process produces green hydrogen and biogenic carbon dioxide for upgrading into biomethanol or SAF, eliminating the need for electrolysers and carbon capture systems.

companies.name: Apleum
companies.description: They are a technology provider for the production of carbon neutral fuels for the aviation and shipping sectors. Their process utilises renewable energy to convert carbon dioxide and water into liquid hydrocarbons through use of electrolysis and catalysis. Carbon neutral fuels can allow the shipping and aviation sectors to immediately lower their emissions at low cost and without disruption to their operations. Their fuel is profitable to produce under current market conditions, with costs predicted to fall and demand predicted to increase over the coming decade. Their process can eliminate up to 3.6 million tonnes of CO2 per year from the UK alone and can be expanded to a scale that will have an impact on global emissions.

companies.name: Natural Building Systems
companies.description: Natural Building Systems has developed a carbon-negative modular system for sustainable construction. Using digital tools, they manufacture structural insulated panels (SIPs) with advanced bio-composites. The SIPs form an integrated ‘kit of parts’ analogous to flat pack furniture, delivered and rapidly assembled using non-specialist labour. Designed for disassembly and adaptation, their system reduces in-use carbon impacts by allowing zero waste alterations and re-use, and reduced operational carbon through improved energy efficiency, climate resilience and indoor air quality. The manufacturing process is energy-efficient and highly scalable.

companies.name: Vundahaus
companies.description: VundaHaus is making homes Vundaful! They are driving the decarbonisation of homes by industrialising the insulation process. Their prefabricated insulation kit can be installed faster than traditional methods and at a fraction of the cost of other off-site solutions. Combining 3D scanning, automated design and efficient off-site manufacture, they will increase the productivity of installer partners and drive down costs for property owners, enabling retrofit at scale.

companies.name: Zori Tex
companies.description: Zori Tex’s mission is to eliminate textile waste to landfill and incineration by innovating in technologies that unlock the value of circular textiles, enabling closed loop textile recycling to rapidly scale. Their solution uses AI driven vision to optimise sorting textile waste by fibre type, integrated with a traceability platform , trading and data analytics.

companies.name: Circular11
companies.description: Circular11 turns low-grade plastic waste into building materials and outdoor construction timber. By combining composite material technology with an innovative process control system, they are creating a functional material, from, and so an end-market for, the cross-contaminated and film-based plastic streams that make up 60% of global plastic waste. At the same-time, they are providing the materials for a zero-carbon built environment.

companies.name: Phoenix Carbon
companies.description: Phoenix Carbon is a composite recycling process, enabling a circular economy for the sustainable use of carbon fiber as a commodity and product across Aero, Auto, Marine and Leisure sectors. This reduces emissions by 87% compared to virgin carbon fiber.​

companies.name: Nium
companies.description: Nium eliminates emissions by delivering hydrogen as a more efficient energy vector. Their novel nanotechnology revolutionises the Haber-Bosch process and enables the synthesis of truly green ammonia.​ With two patents filed, Nium helps build the infrastructure and network for a cleaner future of food and fuel.
companies.team: Lewis Jenkins, CEO Dr. Yubiao Niu, CSO Phil Hunter, COO

companies.name: 17Cicada
companies.description: 17Cicada is developing a bacterial platform for the production of chemicals from waste. Their first-of-its-kind technology produces building blocks for bioplastics, textiles, cosmetic and more. The low-hanging fruit is FDCA, a monomer which can replace terephthalic acid which comes from crude oil and is used to manufacture mainstay plastics.​

companies.name: Materials Nexus
companies.description: Materials Nexus is seeking to revolutionise how new low-carbon sustainable materials are discovered and developed. Typically, getting a new sustainable material to market takes 20 years but this can be markedly reduced using their technology. Their initial focus is on novel alloys and ceramics, leading with high-strength, light-weight recyclable alloys to replace steel in the automotive industry, that promise up to 20% increase in fuel/battery efficiency​.

companies.name: Infyos
companies.description: Electric vehicles promise a future of clean mobility, but their supply chains are complex, opaque and far from clean. Infyos are building a future where every electric vehicle battery is sustainable. Using the team’s expertise in the battery industry and supply chain technology for large organisations around the world, Infyos will help car makers, battery manufacturers and mining companies map and measure the impact of their supply chain, identify hotspots, and enable collaborative action to improve impact and reduce supply chain risk​.

companies.name: MatNex
companies.description: MatNex designs critical materials to specification, turning industrial requirements into validated, protectable material IP.
companies.team: Dr Jonathan Bean, CEO Dr. Robert Forrest, CTO Dr. Jon Pillow, CSO Nic Stirk, CCO

companies.name: Nanoplume
companies.description: NANOPLUME | Manufacturing the next generation of ultra-insulating, affordable, bio-based aerogels to maximize energy efficiency, space efficiency and circularity across industries.
companies.team: Tafadzwa Motsi, COO Tara Love, CTO Theresa Hoffman, CEO
